Title: Security fundamentals
Why: The risks behind most real breaches, in plain terms.

Steps.Text: Read the OWASP Top 10 and note which items apply to your app.
Learn how SQL injection and XSS work, then see how your framework prevents them.
Set up a password manager and two-factor authentication everywhere you can.

Title: Secure web application development
Why: Authentication, sessions, access control and secrets done properly.

Steps.Text: Work through the OWASP cheat sheets for authentication and session management.
Test your own app for broken access control by changing IDs.
Scan a project's dependencies and fix what is found.

Title: Defence in depth and threat thinking
Why: Design for attack: model threats, limit privileges and watch the supply chain.

Steps.Text: Apply least privilege to your cloud roles and tokens.
Read about supply chain attacks and SLSA.
